# Prashanth T. (StarOne01)

> ML Systems Engineer based in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India. Production ASR, compiler infrastructure, and the distributed systems underneath.

Prashanth T. is a self-taught ML Systems Engineer and third-year Electrical & Electronics Engineering student. He builds production ML pipelines, custom ASR systems (Conformer, RNN-T, Whisper fine-tuning with QLoRA), contributes to LLVM, and runs multiple ventures spanning voice-first clinical AI, AI-native dating, and an integrated wellness ecosystem. Stack: Go, Python, TypeScript, C++ (favorite), AWS, GCP.
